verdict.rationale: Temporal is Workflows-as-Code, so workflow definitions live in source control. Its Versioning and Worker Versioning features let new code roll out in versioned deployments while in-flight executions keep running old code paths. Namespaces give isolation that can stand in for environments, and a local dev server supports development. However, no evidence documents a dev-to-production promotion mechanism; this appears to rely on external CI/CD and separate namespaces or clusters. Missing for 10: a documented environment-promotion workflow (dev→staging→prod), guidance on source-control/CI integration, and independent hands-on corroboration of versioned rollouts.
